question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'games_played' as stat,
  MAX(TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER)) as score_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
GROUP BY p.name_given

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'runs' as stat,
  MAX(TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER)) as score_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
GROUP BY p.name_given

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'hits' as stat,
  MAX(TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER)) as score_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
GROUP BY p.name_given

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'home_runs' as stat,
  MAX(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER)) as score_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
GROUP BY p.name_given
